adjudicated.jp: 「フロントホックであれば、こう谷間に差し入れた指で小粋にフィンガースナップを奏でつつホックを外したその瞬間、いましめから解放されたたわわな母なる双丘がたわわんと」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "If a front hook is present, then fingers can be inserted in the cleavage's ravine and sound out a stylish fingersnap as they undo the hook, and on that very instant, the boioingy twin hills of a mother shall be released from bondage and boioioingly..."
comments: 母なる hahahnaru a pretty formal Mother, Mother Nature for example. More interesting: 父なる chichinaru is Father as in God the Father. This is definitely intentional. Also see CCB0002. Given what たわわ both sounds like ("tawawa") and GISes to, it's not even worth thinking of adapting to anything else. More curious considering the Self-Destruct Button prank, see CCD0008C and more, may be a derivative of exactly this primal want for her mother to hurry with the milking already. -GHS

adjudicated.jp: 「自分で思っているほど、たいしたギャグじゃない」
adjudicated.en: Nanaka: "That's not as funny a joke as you think it is inside yourself."
comments: And she knows exactly. -GHS
adjudicated.assessment: 自分で思っているほど means 'as funny as you think it is.' The English adds a literal and redundant interior location.

adjudicated.jp: 「つ……つまりその、揺れる様を鑑賞することかできるから、です！」
adjudicated.en: Taichi: "In-... in other words, because it allows the artistic appreciation of the act of swaying, indeed!"
adjudicated.assessment: The Japanese says he can enjoy watching them sway. The English elevates this to 'artistic appreciation,' nominalizes the motion, and appends an unsupported emphatic tag.
